athena.loss_functions.cross_entropy module

Module for CrossEntropyLoss implementation.

class athena.loss_functions.cross_entropy.CrossEntropyLoss(cfg)[source]

Bases: Module

A simple wrapper around PyTorch’s CrossEntropyLoss.

This loss function is commonly used for multi-class classification tasks.

forward(outputs, targets)[source]

Forward function for CrossEntropyLoss.

Parameters:

  • outputs (torch.Tensor) – The raw logits from the model. Shape: (batch_size, num_classes)

  • targets (torch.Tensor) – The ground truth labels. Shape: (batch_size,)

Returns:

The computed cross-entropy loss.

Return type:

torch.Tensor

athena.loss_functions.hl_gauss module

This module implements HLGaussLoss. This loss make it so that even if Athena predicts a target bin not accurately but next to it, it still gets a small loss.

class athena.loss_functions.hl_gauss.HLGaussLoss(cfg)[source]

Bases: Module

Calculates the KL Divergence between the model’s output distribution and a Gaussian-smoothed target distribution.

forward(outputs, targets)[source]

Forward function for HLGaussLoss.

Parameters:

  • outputs (torch.Tensor) – The raw logits from the model. Shape: (batch_size, output_bins)

  • targets (torch.Tensor) – The one-hot encoded target tensor. Shape: (batch_size, output_bins)
